name: Bakini Noir Patisserie
summary: A single bakery dressed as a dark pastry theatre: a deep stage with ivory type, deep caramel for every action and gold for small accents; Instrument Serif over Manrope; a glass header with the collections, search, a language and currency pill and the bag; a cinematic hero, the collections as tall dark cards, a bento of the shop's real facts, selection rows, a compare strip, deals and the journal; real spec filters, a product page with a sticky buy column and Buy together, a bag drawer, glass checkout cards and a desk account. Dark by default, with an ivory light mode and a footer Theme row.
